conventions.name: module-has-test
conventions.description: A source module has an adjacent named test. Behavioral review is separate.

conventions.name: test-imports-module
conventions.description: A test imports its corresponding source module. This does not establish useful assertions.

conventions.name: provider-factory
conventions.description: Provider exports its settings, interface, and creator. Semantic checks verify settings propagation.

conventions.name: module-export
conventions.description: Require the declared public function; semantic rules check its behavioral contract.
